CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization is present.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates, organization/origin metadata, and a separate status-origin field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the content's organization or access is stated.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content locations with attributes (red/blue) and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Content identification (coordinate sets) is presented separately from origin/status metadata for the same referent.

O.rationale: Origin and represented_time fields describe how the content is organized/represented/accessed (history_estimate, represented_time).
